skill.title: Equal arrows
skill.promise: You can spot arrows with the same displacement.
skill.pipAbility: Pip treats equal arrows as the same move.

lessons.title: Same displacement

screens.prompt: Two arrows each go 3 right from different tails. They are...

feedback.wrong_option: The tails can sit anywhere. The shared move is what matches.

screens.prompt: Both arrows rise the same amount. One rises from 1 to 5. Set the shared rise.

feedback.too_low: The shared rise is the change, and it is larger. Move up.
feedback.too_high: The shared rise is the change, and it is smaller. Move down.

screens.prompt: Match the move of 3 right and 2 up. Start at (1, 1).

feedback.wrong_direction: The move goes right and a little up.
feedback.wrong_length: The direction matches. The run is 3 and the rise is 2.

screens.correctMessage: That displacement matches the other arrow.

screens.prompt: A model treats equal arrows as what?

options.label: Different features, because they start apart

feedback.wrong_option: The start can change. The move is the feature.

screens.prompt: Arrow A is (+2, +0). Arrow B is (+2, +1). Are they equal?

feedback.wrong_option: They share the run, but B also rises. The moves differ.

screens.correctMessage: One extra step up makes a different arrow.

lessons.whyItMatters: Equal vectors are the same feature, wherever they start.
